notes: Work Order Capability Manifest · Phase 8 v0.1.6. Machine-verifiable Ed25519-signed structure attached to every Work Order. Broker evaluates every capability request against Founder Authorisation × Work Order × Capability Manifest.

manifest_fields.read_roots: array of workspace-relative + explicitly-founder-authorised project roots (narrow allowlist)
manifest_fields.protected_paths: array · hard denies · always inherited from mandatory exclusions regardless of Work Order authoring
manifest_fields.read_denylist: array · hard denies · always inherited (.env* · **/*.pem · **/id_rsa* · .git/** · .npmrc · credentials* · founder-authorised-*.sig · .nex/authority/** · node_modules/** for direct read)
manifest_fields.allowed_environment: object · whitelisted env var names + fixed values
manifest_fields.network_policy: DENY (default) OR object with explicit outbound allowlist (rare · founder-authored)
manifest_fields.resource_limits: object · cpu_ms_max · memory_bytes_max · wall_ms_max · fd_max · total_write_bytes_max · process_count_max
manifest_fields.timeout: int seconds · wall-clock deadline for the whole Work Order
manifest_fields.interpretation_authority: object · what NEX1 may reinterpret at will (usually 'nothing' · founder-authored)
manifest_fields.founder_authorisation_signature: Ed25519 signature over the manifest by founder-held key

process_capability_entry_fields.executable_absolute_path: resolved once at broker start · pinned
process_capability_entry_fields.executable_hash: sha256 of the resolved binary · pinned
process_capability_entry_fields.executable_version: e.g. 'v20.11.0' · must match at spawn time
process_capability_entry_fields.stdio_policy: stdin=/dev/null · stdout+stderr captured to Broker event log

invariants: Manifest is Ed25519-signed by a founder-held key at Work Order authoring
Broker verifies signature at Work Order intake · refuses if invalid
Manifest is IMMUTABLE for the duration of the Work Order · manifest_hash pinned
Every capability request is evaluated against Founder Authorisation ∧ Work Order ∧ Capability Manifest
Manifest additions require founder authoring · never runtime-generated
Requests touching fields not enumerated in the Manifest are DENIED by default
